speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned chronic bladder discomfort and frequent urination; to better understand your condition, how long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and do you notice any pain specifically when you urinate?

speaker: Patient
text: 40-year-old female. The patient reports a 5-month history of worsening bladder discomfort, which is relieved by voiding. speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that detailed history; the relief of symptoms upon urination and the presence of dyspareunia are significant clues. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Interstitial Cystitis (Painful Bladder Syndrome)
